data.name: Guide To Apocalypse
data.detailed_description:
Guide to Apocalypse

Built with Unreal Engine 5, Guide to Apocalypse is a linear narrative survival game that blends third-person shooting, Wing Chun close combat, and branching storylines.

Story

In 2028, a nuclear fusion accident in the Pacific unleashed the mutant parasite virus HELIX-731. Cities burned to ash to contain the outbreak, and global order survived only under crushing pressure, fractured among three rival factions.
By 2032, the virus consumes Riverburg overnight. This is the city where you and your loved one live—within three days, choices of loyalty and betrayal will decide your fate: escape to the stars, hold onto love, or confront the darkness of humanity.

Core Gameplay

  • Firearms: Third-person combat with free switching between single pistols, dual pistols, and assault rifles. Bullet-time abilities expand your tactical options.

  • Wing Chun: Traditional Chinese martial arts integrated into melee, combining combos, blocks, and recovery for a unique fighting system.

Zombie Ecology

  • Appearance: Each zombie varies in look, clothing, and infection stage—no two encounters feel the same.

  • Dismemberment: Detailed damage and limb loss provide visceral shooting feedback.

  • Cooperation: Zombies act as a swarm. Females sense danger and shriek to summon allies, while males charge with relentless aggression. Survival depends on reading the situation.

Diverse Environments

Beyond realistic urban ruins, the story expands into surreal stages with different playable characters.

Rich Narrative

Driven by story at every step, your decisions shape carefully designed branching endings. 

Apocalyptic Aesthetics

This game seeks to make zombie shooters more than blood and gore — to use the medium itself as an art form. Through story and performance, it creates a new kind of apocalyptic beauty: a romantic elegy to humanity and the stars, written amid the ruins.

data.short_description: A deep-sea reactor accident unleashed a mutant virus worldwide. In cities scarred by infection, the dead roam, factions war, and betrayal mingles with redemption. In this indie blend of Wing Chun combat, third-person shooting, and branching story, face choices of love, ideals, and survival.

English, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5 4th
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i7 7th
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains some violent and horror scenes. It also features dismemberment and blood splatter effects when shooting zombies.
